user_story.title: Automated Lead Management and Sales Process Optimization
user_story.trigger: New lead creation from multiple sources (trade shows, website, social media, referrals, outbound calls)
user_story.current_pain_point: Manual spreadsheet management is slowing down follow-up speed and response times
user_story.desired_outcome: Automated lead processing with integrated task creation, approval workflows, and email tracking to maintain 24-hour response times

process_requirements.description: Capture leads from multiple sources with standard fields: product interest, estimated monthly volume (pounds), region, preferred contact method
process_requirements.automation_needed: Auto-create lead records from various entry points

process_requirements.description: Follow standard Salesforce pipeline stages: Qualification, Proposal/Price Quote, Negotiation/Review, Closed Won
Automated approval workflow for quotes with discounts above 15%, routing to the regional sales manager for sign-off
process_requirements.automation_needed: Conditional approval routing based on discount percentage to regional sales manager

process_requirements.description: Auto-create two tasks for every new opportunity: send sample pack (within 3 days) and schedule pricing call (within 10 days)
process_requirements.automation_needed: Task creation with specific due dates based on opportunity creation

process_requirements.description: Ensure email replies log back to Salesforce to maintain response times under 24 hours
process_requirements.automation_needed: Email-to-case or similar integration for tracking communications

success_criteria: Lead follow-up speed improved by eliminating spreadsheet dependency
All quotes with >15% discount automatically routed to the regional sales manager for approval
Every new opportunity has sample pack and pricing call tasks created automatically
Email response times maintained under 24 hours through Salesforce tracking
systems_involved: Lead sources (trade shows, website, social media, referrals, outbound calls)

questions_for_user: For the sample pack task - should this be assigned to a specific role (like sales rep) or to the opportunity owner?
For the pricing call task - should this be assigned to the same person as the sample pack task, or to a different role?
When you mention 'email replies log back to Salesforce' - do you want this to create cases, log activities on the lead/opportunity, or both?
Are there any specific conditions when leads should NOT auto-create opportunities (e.g., certain regions, product types, or volume thresholds)?
Should the 3-day and 10-day task deadlines be business days or calendar days?
